name: Noah (daughter of Zelophehad)
title: One of Zelophehad's five daughters
summary: Noah was one of Zelophehad's five daughters who asked Moses to let them inherit their father, since he died without sons. The case led to a new inheritance law in Israel that gave daughters the right to inherit when there were no sons.

keyEvents.title: Demanding Inheritance Rights
keyEvents.description: The daughters of Zelophehad came forward before Moses and demanded to inherit their father, and the Lord confirmed that their claim was right.
